question: Give me the full list of engineering branches.
answer: EGSPEC reports 11 undergraduate programs. The official Bachelor's page lists: Mechanical Engineering; Artificial Intelligence and Data Science; Civil Engineering; Electrical and Electronics Engineering; Electronics and Communication Engineering; Computer Science and Engineering; Information Technology; Biomedical Engineering; Computer Science and Business Systems; Cyber Security; and Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The Master's page names six engineering specializations: Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Power Electronics and Drives, Communication Systems, and Environmental Engineering. The website also has postgraduate departments for MBA and MCA. The official history page reports 9 PG programs in total.

question: What degrees can I study at EGSPASC?
answer: The official EGSPASC course list includes UG programs: B.Com, B.Com Computer Applications, B.Com Business Process Service, B.B.A., B.A. Defence and Strategic Studies, B.Sc Computer Science, B.Sc Computer Science (Cognitive Systems), B.C.A., B.Sc Information Technology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Nutrition & Dietetics, Visual Communication, Fashion Technology and Costume Designing, Hospital Administration, B.A. Tamil, and B.A. English. The official programmes page also lists newer UG offerings including B.Com Professional Accounting, B.Sc Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, and Microbiology. PG programs include M.Sc Chemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Food Science and Nutrition, Physics, Mathematics, M.Com, M.A. English, and MBA. Research programs listed are Ph.D. Commerce, Management, Biochemistry, Computer Science, Biotechnology, English, and Physics.

question: D Pharm B Pharm Pharm D and M Pharm duration sollu.
answer: The official Pharmacy site lists D.Pharm (2 years, intake 60), B.Pharm (4 years, intake 100; 3-year lateral entry after D.Pharm), Pharm.D (6 years, intake 30), and M.Pharm (2 years) with Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, and Pharmacology branches. Typical scope includes community and hospital pharmacy, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality assurance and control, regulatory affairs, clinical pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, research, and higher studies. Eligibility varies by course and must be checked against the current admission notification.

question: What training and recognition does the nursing college offer?
answer: The official Nursing admissions page lists B.Sc. Nursing and DGNM programs. It highlights clinical training in reputed hospitals, modern clinical laboratories and simulation kits, experienced faculty mentorship, and 100% placement assistance. The page also states accreditation by the Indian Nursing Council (INC). Career paths can include hospital and community nursing, public health, clinical specializations, nursing administration, education, and higher studies, subject to the qualification and applicable registration requirements.

question: Which diploma streams are aided and self-financed?
answer: The official Polytechnic site lists 3-year Diploma programs. Government-aided courses include Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, and Instrumentation and Control Engineering. Self-financing courses include Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. First-year Basic Engineering is common, followed by the allotted branch across six semesters. The college was established in 2006, is affiliated to DOTE Tamil Nadu, and highlights workshops, laboratories, placement support, and lateral-entry options to B.E.
